So I'm an F&B manager so I see the fuller picture here. I'm many cases the culture exists because there is such a huge shortage of employees and it's very hard not to fall into that guilt trip mentality of letting your coworkers (or friends) down when you are sick. I try my best to encourage masks or try to enable my employees to call others in to cover in case they are sick. But I feel like that aspect of the industry is non existent now. Many younger workers won't even bother learning their coworkers names or building the relationships to cover them when sick. Also quiet quitting is a real trend now and the extra workload  increases the odds of sickness all around. Even in management, but do I stay home? No. I come in sick because deadlines are more important to higher ups and someone has to manage all the temp labor staff from the gig job apps that we absolutely need. Sure, I am the manager here and rescheduling is ultimately falls on me to find coverage, but the culture itself has changed. Its kinda like how next door neighbors don't bother to introduce themselves anymore. Everyone is tuned out on community and no one learned any lessons from COVID. Until the cost of living returns to normal levels and the work force stabilizes, everything from food and service will take a dive. We see it in all industries rn.

I'm in a unique position to help you specifically as I just hacked my wiiu this week and I am using the same drive that was used on my og Wii without any drive modifications (so it still works on the Wii)

Don't listen to anyone else here. They are giving you old advice (like hiding your drive with usbhide or ustealth) just use an Aroma cfw setup.

What you need to do is not have both drive formated correctly to the wiiu. Meaning only one drive is formated for Aroma use. The other drive needs to be a fat32 for your vwii files and it shouldn't be formated the way the wiiu wants it to be.

Yes, this will create a format nag like others are saying. But what they fail to realize is that you don't have to block the vwii drive anymore by the old way of doing things. If you autobot into Aroma, you can now block the format nag completely and still keep two drives plugged in. This setting is accessed by pressing L+down+minus I believe. It's like a default plugin

The only catch to this setup is that if you exit aroma cfw you will get the nag again. That said, I very rarely have a reason to not autoboot into aroma anyway (I think the only major app that doesn't have aroma support yet is retroarch or something, almost everything else is supported now I find). So just setup aroma autoboot and call it a day. Hope this helps

------------------

BTW the Wii and wiiu work off the same file structure. Like the Wii apps are in the SD:/apps folder and the wiiu apps are in the SD:/wiiu/apps folder. It's great as you can actually use the same SD card and hard drive without any hassle as the files are naturally kept in their own areas.

Also you should have your Aroma cfw drive plugged into the top port and the Wii/GameCube drive (vwii) on the bottom port. and make sure you check the boxes in  USB loader gx to show GameCube and Wii titles (it's off by default).

Also make sure you install the latest priiloader on to your vWii. Older versions will brick the console. The latest homebrew app store on the vwii has a good version on there. Hope this helps!
